subject: general
question:
In the given figure, AB and CD are parallel lines intersected by a transversal PQ at L and M, respectively. If ∠CMQ = 48°, then ∠PLA is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f3bbd53fd77c6b46b99375133ebe17abfc600465337a6b6dee12e3e5834a6666.png]
solution:
**Given:**

 ∠CMQ = 48°

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f3bbd53fd77c6b46b99375133ebe17abfc600465337a6b6dee12e3e5834a6666.png] 

**Calculation:**

According to the question,

∠CMQ = 48°

So, ∠CML 

= 180° - ∠CMQ (Supplementary angles)

= 180° - 48°

= 132°

And ∠CML = ∠PLA = 132° (Corresponding angles)

**Hence, The Required angle is 132°.**
